reviewProvenance.manualVisualComparison: Source position 2 and canonical production cover show the identical crouching, massively muscular Bane wearing a respirator mask and large neon-green venom tubes, standing on a dark rubble pedestal with green liquid; the two other Bane candidates are different statue models.
reviewProvenance.identityProofInterpretation: Explicit visual matching of sculpture, pose, base and staging, corroborated by verified source SHA-256 and canonical dHash. Other source name matches were not auto-approved.

mediaReview.notes: ZZ studio watermark appears on both source and public cover; rights for import of additional angles are not established. Do not import/crop/alter promotional marks, add gallery or replace current cover based on identity approval.

decision.nextGate: Keep one canonical model and review source media rights/branding separately before publication.
